summary: I tested the 'Gruppo di appartenenza' feature end to end, on the backend and in the UI. Backend: 15 pytest tests (tests/test_gruppi_appartenenza.py), 14 pass. The one failure is a permission bypass: an org admin can rewrite the group list through the generic PUT /api/settings, skipping the Super Admin-only rule. UI (Playwright, desktop and mobile), all checks pass. Public link: the field sits just before the activity question, 'Nessun gruppo' (italic) is selected by default, the option order is correct, '+ Aggiungi gruppo' opens the dialog, an empty name is refused, a new group is auto-selected and the other filled fields are kept. The activity is still required, and the submit saves the group on the person. Staff/Volontari: in the staff, volontari and da_classificare tabs the column sits between Mansione and Evento. 'Nessun gruppo' shows when empty, long names are truncated with a title tooltip, and filter (all/none/specific), search and sort (asc/desc) work, as does the mobile m-gruppo row. The edit mask saves the group and Team/Mansione are still there. Settings: the list appears under Staff e Volontari with search, empty state and per-group counts. An org admin can add (duplicates ignoring case and spaces are merged) but sees no rename/delete buttons and gets 403 on the API. A Super Admin with Org attiva Nova can rename (records updated) and delete: the confirm shows the number of people, the person is unlinked and still exists. Groups stay in their own org. A group created from a public link lands in the link's org even when a Super Admin session sends X-Org-Id of another org. 'Nessun gruppo' is refused when adding or renaming.

minor.issue: Permission bypass (confirmed by test_org_admin_generic_settings_put_bypass). An org admin can $set gruppi_appartenenza through the generic settings PUT and remove groups, including groups in use, without unlinking. This skips the 'only Super Admin can rename/delete' rule, leaves stale group values on persons and could store 'Nessun gruppo'. Fix: in update_settings, drop option_lists.ORG_ONLY keys (and disattivati.gruppi_appartenenza) from the body unless the caller passes _is_manager.

availabilities.gruppo_appartenenza (set in pub_avail_submit) is not in LISTS['gruppi_appartenenza'] targets, so rename/delete leave the old group name on availability records (verified: after delete the person was null but the availability still had the deleted name). It is not shown in the UI today. Either add ('availabilities','gruppo_appartenenza') to the targets, or document it as a historical snapshot and do not count it.

gruppo_appartenenza is not checked against the org's group list or the reserved name. Any string, including 'Nessun gruppo' or a deleted group, can be saved through the API. The UI only offers valid values.

When the person already exists, a submitted group overwrites their current group with no mismatch tracking, unlike the other fields. Matching the group name ignores case but does not collapse inner spaces the way public_add does. Low impact.

integration_issues.issue: Adding a duplicate shows the toast 'Voce aggiunta' even when the API returns created:false, so the user may think a new group was created. Show 'Gruppo già presente' instead.

issues: Delete uses native window.confirm and not a shadcn AlertDialog, unlike the rest of the app
Count label says '1 voci' on other cards (plural for 1); the groups card is fine ('1 persona')
The empty group shows '—' and the clear option reads '— Nessuna —'. It should read 'Nessun gruppo' to match the table and public form.
The new people-gruppo-filter wraps alone onto a second line under the filter row; acceptable but slightly unbalanced

action_items: Block org admins from changing gruppi_appartenenza through the generic PUT /api/settings: strip ORG_ONLY keys unless the caller is Super Admin.
Decide what happens to availabilities.gruppo_appartenenza on rename/delete: include it in the LISTS targets or document it as a snapshot.
Optionally check persons.gruppo_appartenenza on PUT /api/persons against the org list and the reserved name.
Show an 'already present' message when adding a duplicate group in Settings.
Label the mask's empty/clear option 'Nessun gruppo'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_settings sets the raw body with no key allowlist; this is the root cause of the ORG_ONLY bypass.
option_lists.public_add uses $push with no atomic dedupe; two requests at the same moment with the same name can both push. Use a conditional update or $addToSet on the normalized value.
Files are very large: server.py has 14k+ lines (pre-existing). Persons.jsx is 539 lines (fine).
